ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity (off-white/cream) pixels localized on the outer lobes to 65% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels dominating the central region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-intensity white patches are located on the lateral-most margins of both lobes. The central-inner region is primarily low-intensity black, exhibiting significant high-frequency white speckling and mottled patterns where the dark and light regions interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth ratio of approximately 1:6 relative to the vertical span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge span; characterized by numerous peaks and valleys with 5-15 pixel amplitudes. A distinct macro-notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer perspective).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, dorsally-curved apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of small, circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 2-8 pixels in diameter) across the central dark pigment area, consistent with sessile organism attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of distinct, parallel linear white pixel trajectories (rake marks) are visible; most prominent on the lower-center of both lobes, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged traumatic loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer perspective) and extensive healed linear scarring (rake marks) across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of yellowish-brown, high-texture pixel clusters (likely barnacle colonies) localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
